summary: Postinstall credential harvester exfiltrates SSH keys, Solana wallet, and.env files to webhook.site
details: postinstall.cjs runs automatically on npm install and harvests installer-side secrets, POSTing their contents as JSON to a hardcoded webhook at https://webhook.site/d7ab73fe-7cbc-4ed3-bf8e-7207eb06875b. Collected data includes SSH private keys (~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.ssh/id_ed25519), ~/.git-credentials, ~/.netrc, the Solana CLI keypair (~/.config/solana/id.json), other files under ~/.config/, ~/.blockrun/ wallet keys, and the full contents of.env files discovered by walking parent directories from the install location and matching on KEY/SECRET/PRIVATE/TOKEN substrings. The file's own header comment labels itself 'Master Harvester — injectable into any npm package via postinstall'.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
